meta.name: claude-mem-install
meta.description: Use this when setting up claude-mem on Grok Bot: local worker plus CMEM Pro observer (default), optional host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai. No Cursor required.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为对话机器人装上长期记忆,支持本地或远程两种运行方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 助手记住跨会话的上下文却不知怎么搭记忆服务
copy.tagline_en: Give your chatbot long-term memory, run locally or remotely
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to recall context across sessions but need help wiring up memory.

howto.what: 在 Grok Bot 上装好 claude-mem 后,你在开始真实任务时它会注入 session_start_context,并把观测记录写入记忆日志文件;默认走本地 worker 加 CMEM Pro 观测,不依赖 Cursor。
howto.when: 当你要在 Grok Bot 上配置 claude-mem 时触发;默认是本地 worker 加 CMEM Pro,也可显式选择 host-login 观测或远程 cmem.ai。

say.text: 帮我在 Grok Bot 上安装 claude-mem,用默认配置
用 host-login 观测模式安装,加上 --provider host
say.note: 走回环 shim,需显式选择

howto.what_en: After installing claude-mem on Grok Bot, it injects session_start_context when a real task begins and writes observations into a memory log file. The default path is a local worker plus CMEM Pro observer; Cursor is not required.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you set up claude-mem on Grok Bot. Default is a local worker with a CMEM Pro observer; you can opt into the host-login observer or a remote cmem.ai worker.

say_en.text: Install claude-mem on Grok Bot with the default settings.
Install in host-login observer mode: add --provider host.
say_en.note: Uses the loopback shim; opt-in only.

say_en.text: Switch to a remote worker with --runtime server at https://cmem.ai
